prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: The cabinet can open either way. Which side should I put the hinges on?
spokenPromptZh: 櫃門可以向任一側開。我應該把鉸鏈裝在哪一側？

options.text: The screws are in the plastic tray.
options.whyZh: 只提供工具零件的位置，沒有指定鉸鏈的安裝側。

options.text: On the left, so the door won't block the outlet on the right.
options.zh: 裝左側，這樣櫃門就不會擋住右邊的插座。
options.whyZh: 明確選左側，補充裝在這側的空間理由。

options.text: It was delivered without a handle.
options.whyZh: 描述缺少門把，沒有回應鉸鏈裝哪邊。

explanationZh: 明確選左側，補充裝在這側的空間理由。
evidence: The cabinet can open either way. Which side should I put the hinges on? / On the left, so the door won't block the outlet on the right.

vocabulary.note: 決定門片固定在哪一側以及朝哪個方向開啟。
